description: This file contains unit tests for the ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl class, verifying its methods for creating field expressions based on various input parameters related to thing definitions, features, and attributes within a query expression framework.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ThingsFieldExpressionFactoryImpl, testing various methods for creating field expressions based on thing attributes, features, and definitions.

methods.name: filterByWithNullPropertyName
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy(null) throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: filterByWithUnknownPropertyName
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy('unknown') throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: filterByWithFeaturePropertyWithId
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy(KNOWN_FEATURE_PROPERTY_WITH_ID) returns a FeatureIdPropertyExpressionImpl with expected feature ID and property.

methods.name: filterByWithFeature
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy(KNOWN_FEATURE) throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: existsByWithNullPropertyName
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy(null) throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: existsByWithUnknownPropertyName
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy('unknown') throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: existsByWithFeaturePropertyWithId
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy(KNOWN_FEATURE_PROPERTY_WITH_ID) returns an ExistsFieldExpression with expected feature ID and property.

methods.name: existsByWithFeature
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy(KNOWN_FEATURE) returns an ExistsFieldExpression with expected feature ID.

methods.name: existsByWithJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy('/features/feature1') returns an expected ExistsFieldExpression.

methods.name: sortByWithFeatureProperty
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortBy(KNOWN_FEATURE_PROPERTY_WITH_ID) returns a SortFieldExpression similar to the feature property expression.

methods.name: sortByWithJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortBy('/features/feature1/properties/KNOWN_STRING') returns an expected SortFieldExpression.

methods.name: sortByWithFeaturePropertyInvalid1
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortBy(KNOWN_FEATURE) throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: filterByWithAttribute
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy(FieldExpressionUtil.addAttributesPrefix(KNOWN_STRING)) returns an AttributeExpressionImpl.

methods.name: filterByWithThingId
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy(FieldExpressionUtil.FIELD_NAME_THING_ID) returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl with FieldExpressionUtil.FIELD_ID.

methods.name: filterByWithJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy('/thingId') returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl for the thing ID.

methods.name: filterByFeatureIdAndProperty
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterByFeatureProperty with feature ID and property returns a FeatureIdPropertyExpressionImpl.

methods.name: sortByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortByFeatureProperty returns a SortFieldExpression similar to the feature property expression.

methods.name: filterByAttribute
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterByAttribute returns an AttributeExpressionImpl.

methods.name: sortByAttribute
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortByAttribute returns an AttributeExpressionImpl.

methods.name: filterByThingId
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterByThingId returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl with the thing ID field.

methods.name: sortByThingId
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortByThingId returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl for the thing ID.

methods.name: filterByDefinition
methods.description: Tests that ef.filterBy returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl with the provided thing definition.

methods.name: sortByDefinition
methods.description: Tests that ef.sortBy returns a SimpleFieldExpressionImpl with the provided thing definition.

methods.name: existsByWithDefinition
methods.description: Tests that ef.existsBy returns an expression matching the provided thing definition.
